8idOITmT_BJiRhpkM540RA.zh: 蒙古2026年在北部庫蘇古爾省(Khuvsgul)進行監測,確認當地為鼠疫自然疫源地,另在中國邊境之科布多省(Khovd)發現1例腺鼠疫確定病例,與處理來自巴彥烏列蓋省(Bayan-Ölgii)已知疫源區之旱獺有關。目前尚無證據顯示人際間傳播,由於旱獺獵捕為主要傳播途徑,且偏遠地區診療不易,當局呼籲⺠眾勿接觸野生旱獺。
8idOITmT_BJiRhpkM540RA.en: In 2026, Mongolia conducted surveillance in Khuvsgul Province in the north and confirmed that the area is a natural plague focus. In addition, one confirmed case of bubonic plague was detected in Khovd Province on the Chinese border, linked to handling marmots from the known plague focus in Bayan-Ölgii Province. There is currently no evidence of human-to-human transmission. Because marmot hunting is the main transmission route and diagnosis and treatment in remote areas are difficult, authorities urge people not to come into contact with wild marmots.

2RHOOUR6Qffg2k5bU9lf8A.zh: 蒙古今年截至4/6累計報告7例確診(含3例死亡),超越近3年病例數,分布於烏蘭巴托、達爾汗烏拉、科布多、烏布蘇等省份,且個案均為6個月至10歲幼童。此外,科布多省於3月曾發生校園群聚(2名個案,其中1名死亡),當局已匡列隔離48名接觸者進行相關防治工作。WHO已介入協助醫療培訓,因致病血清群仍未明且流行期將持續至6月,當局呼籲民眾提高警覺。
2RHOOUR6Qffg2k5bU9lf8A.en: As of 6 April this year, Mongolia had reported seven confirmed cases cumulatively, including three deaths, exceeding case numbers over the past three years. Cases are distributed across Ulaanbaatar, Darkhan-Uul, Khovd, Uvs and other areas, and all cases were young children aged six months to 10 years. In addition, a school cluster occurred in Khovd Province in March (two cases, one of whom died), and authorities have identified and quarantined 48 contacts. WHO has been involved in supporting medical training. Because the causative serogroup is still unidentified and the epidemic season will continue until June, authorities urge the public to remain alert.

coFcsT-5v-JNJs-f0Oqsug.zh: 蒙古中部後杭愛省(Arkhangai)報告1例皮膚炭疽病例,病患於發病前曾屠宰大量牛隻,刻正住院隔離中,當局針對病患及家屬居住之地區實施部分隔離,另持續進行疫情監測及檢疫等措施。
coFcsT-5v-JNJs-f0Oqsug.en: Mongolia reported one case of cutaneous anthrax in Arkhangai Province in central Mongolia. The patient slaughtered large numbers of cattle before falling ill and is currently hospitalized in isolation. Authorities have imposed partial quarantine in the areas where the patient and family live, and continue surveillance, quarantine and other control measures.

hsdcMh8ijie9Es-i9lP_zg.zh: 蒙古報告3例病例,已追蹤110名接觸者,目前該國17個省列為風險地區,當局暫時限制大型活動並採取遠距教學,以避免爆發疫情;2014至2024年共報告20例病例及9例死亡。
hsdcMh8ijie9Es-i9lP_zg.en: Mongolia has reported three cases and has traced 110 contacts. Seventeen provinces across the country are currently listed as risk areas. Authorities have temporarily restricted large gatherings and adopted distance learning to prevent outbreaks. From 2014 to 2024, a total of 20 cases and 9 deaths were reported.

vtqJo95ZdO4pL2soABPqFw.zh: 以色列今年4月截至8/10累計報告410例,當局評估該國感染人數介於950-1,700人間,並報告22例住院,其中包含2名嬰幼兒重症案例,該國已啟動疫苗接種活動。 蒙古今年截至8/7累計報告逾1.3萬例,其中10例死亡,病例多為未接種疫苗之兒童,該國於2015-16年期間爆發疫情,報告140例死亡,多數為嬰幼兒。 韓國今年截至8/9累計報告68例,其中49例境外移入及19例與境外移入病例相關病例,病例數為去年同期1.4倍,感染國家以越南42例為多,餘有南非/烏茲別克/泰國/義大利/蒙古,病例多為19歲以上成年人,過半數病例未接種疫苗或接種史不詳。 日本東京都病例數上升,今年截至8/7累計報告28例,超過去年全年病例數(10例),因連續假期將至,外出返鄉人潮增加,當局加強警戒。
vtqJo95ZdO4pL2soABPqFw.en: Israel: 410 cases have been reported since April this year, as of 10 August. Authorities estimate that the number of infected people in the country is between 950 and 1,700. A total of 22 cases were hospitalized, including two severe cases in infants and young children, and the country has launched a vaccination campaign. Mongolia: as of 7 August this year, more than 13,000 cases had been cumulatively reported, including 10 deaths; cases are mostly in unvaccinated children. Mongolia had an outbreak in 2015–16 that reported 140 deaths, most of them infants and young children. South Korea: as of 9 August this year, 68 cases had been cumulatively reported, of which 49 were imported and 19 were linked to imported cases; case numbers are 1.4 times those of the same period last year. Most infections were acquired in Viet Nam (42 cases), with others from South Africa, Uzbekistan, Thailand, Italy and Mongolia. Most cases are adults aged 19 and over, and more than half were unvaccinated or had an unknown vaccination history. Tokyo Metropolis, Japan: case numbers are rising; as of 7 August this year, 28 cases had been cumulatively reported, exceeding last year's full-year total of 10 cases. With the holiday period approaching and more people travelling out and returning home, authorities have increased vigilance.

3nkSQVZOk4BA2gLUpTyCXw.zh: 加拿大今年截至7/5共10省報告3,822例,其中以安大略省及亞伯達省為多,亞伯達省病例數上升,截至7/14報告逾1,200例,當地疫情嚴峻,該省已針對南部及北部部分地區發布警報,由於夏季大型集會增加及學校即將開學,預期疫情風險將持續。 美國今年迄今共39州報告1,288例,已報告27起疫情,病例數已超過2019年全年病例數,為該國宣布消除麻疹以來最高紀錄,該國有近1/3病例為20歲以上成人,92%個案未接種疫苗或接種史不明,自德州於今年1月發生大規模疫情後,已有多個州爆發小規模疫情,同時有大量境外移入個案。 韓國今年截至7/5累計報告65例,所有病例皆為境外移入及其相關個案,感染地以越南(42例)為多,餘有烏茲別克、義大利、泰國及蒙古等國,病患多為19歲以上成年人。 英國利物浦報告1例兒童死亡案例,為英蘭地區近5年來第2例死亡,前1例為2023年大曼徹斯特10歲女童,英蘭地區今年迄今報告529例,以倫敦都會區為多,該地區去年報告2,900餘例,為2012年以來新高。
3nkSQVZOk4BA2gLUpTyCXw.en: Canada has reported 3,822 cases in 10 provinces as of 5 July this year, mainly in Ontario and Alberta. Alberta's case count has risen, with more than 1,200 cases reported as of 14 July. The epidemic there is severe, and the province has issued alerts for parts of the south and north. Because of increased large summer gatherings and the imminent start of school, the risk is expected to continue. The United States has reported 1,288 cases in 39 states so far this year, with 27 outbreaks reported. The number of cases has already exceeded the total for all of 2019, the highest since the country declared measles eliminated. Nearly one third of cases are adults aged over 20, and 92% of cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Since a large outbreak in Texas in January this year, several states have experienced small outbreaks, alongside many imported cases. South Korea reported 65 cases as of 5 July this year, all imported or linked to imported cases. Most were from Viet Nam (42 cases), with others from Uzbekistan, Italy, Thailand and Mongolia, and most patients were adults aged 19 and over. In Liverpool, United Kingdom, one child died; this is the second death in England in five years, the previous being a 10-year-old girl in Greater Manchester in 2023. England has reported 529 cases so far this year, mainly in Greater London. England reported more than 2,900 cases last year, the highest since 2012.

FAMzDA2nfrnXdqiqwChhgw.zh: 玻利維亞於6/24發布公共衛生緊急狀態,該國自4月報告首例以來迄今報告60例,病例多分布於該國東部聖克魯斯省,惟近期疫情擴散至該國西部地區,當局將規劃疫苗採購及接種計畫。 蒙古今年截至6/30累計報告逾10,000例,其中648例住院及7例死亡,病例多為中學生。
FAMzDA2nfrnXdqiqwChhgw.en: Bolivia declared a public health emergency on 24 June. Since the first case was reported in April this year, 60 cases have been reported to date. Cases are mainly in Santa Cruz Department in the east, but the outbreak has recently spread to western regions. Authorities will plan vaccine procurement and vaccination programs. Mongolia has reported more than 10,000 cumulative cases as of 30 June this year, including 648 hospitalized and 7 deaths. Most cases are secondary school students.

0vyPBSg9CJyF4xa0r4Rhsw.zh: 蒙古疫情嚴峻,今年截至6/12累計報告逾6,500例及6例死亡,該國僅近3週新增已超過3,600例,此波疫情主要影響未接種疫苗之學齡兒童,多數病例發生於10-14歲年齡層,由於疫情快速蔓延且接觸者眾多,尤其在首都烏蘭巴托等人口密集處,構成持續傳播風險。 荷蘭報告1例死亡病例,病患為具免疫系統相關疾病之成年人,於5月下旬住院,感染源仍不明。該國今年截至6/4累計報告437例,其中50例為境外移入,多數病例為境外移入個案及相關接觸者,目前皆為小規模群聚,尚未發生全國性疫情,該國上次發生大規模疫情為2013-14年。
0vyPBSg9CJyF4xa0r4Rhsw.en: Mongolia's outbreak is severe. As of 12 June this year, more than 6,500 cases and 6 deaths have been reported cumulatively, with more than 3,600 of the cases added in just the past three weeks. The outbreak mainly affects unvaccinated school-age children, with most cases aged 10–14. Because the outbreak is spreading rapidly and there are many contacts, especially in densely populated areas such as the capital, Ulaanbaatar, it poses a continuing risk of transmission. The Netherlands reported one death, an adult with an immune-system-related disease who was hospitalized in late May; the source of infection remains unknown. The country has reported 437 cumulative cases this year as of 4 June, 50 of them imported. Most are imported cases and their contacts, and currently these are small clusters; no nationwide outbreak has occurred. The country's last large-scale outbreak was in 2013–14.

eTwNsoalPwviurRM_Bytwg.zh: 美洲:美國今年截至5/29報告14起疫情,累計33州1,088例,其中133例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾740例為多,近期德州地區疫情已趨緩,惟其他州仍持續報告零星病例,南達科他州報告今年首例;墨西哥今年截至5/12報告逾 4,200例,其中1,520例確診及4例死亡,以奇瓦瓦州(1,434)為多。 亞洲:吉爾吉斯今年截至5/27累計報告逾7,300例,主要分布於首都比斯凱克,另北部楚河州及南部奧什州病例數亦較高,疫情分布廣泛,遍及都會及農村地區,94%病例未接種疫苗;蒙古今年迄今報告3,100餘例,病例主要集中於校園,當局呼籲學生、教職員及與學齡族群密切接觸人員接種疫苗。 非洲:摩洛哥今年累計報告超過40,000例,其中79例死亡(CFR:0.2%),目前當局持續進行全國性疫苗接種。
eTwNsoalPwviurRM_Bytwg.en: Americas: as of 29 May this year, the United States has reported 14 outbreaks, with 1,088 cases cumulatively across 33 states, including 133 hospitalizations and 3 deaths. Texas has the most, with over 740 cases. The Texas outbreak has recently slowed, but other states continue to report sporadic cases, and South Dakota reported its first case this year. As of 12 May, Mexico had reported over 4,200 cases this year, including 1,520 confirmed cases and 4 deaths, mainly in Chihuahua State (1,434). Asia: as of 27 May this year, Kyrgyzstan has reported over 7,300 cases cumulatively, mainly in the capital Bishkek, with high numbers also in the northern Chui Region and the southern Osh Region. The outbreak is widespread across urban and rural areas, and 94% of cases were unvaccinated. Mongolia has reported over 3,100 cases so far this year, concentrated in schools, and authorities urge students, school staff and people in close contact with school-age children to be vaccinated. Africa: Morocco has reported more than 40,000 cases cumulatively this year, including 79 deaths (CFR 0.2%), and nationwide vaccination is ongoing.

0Gw2ZQP6rlwLroUpNULjkg.zh: 蒙古西部烏布蘇省11/14報告新增2例病例,均曾宰殺或食用同一頭病牛,另有9例共同暴露者,已進行隔離觀察中。
0Gw2ZQP6rlwLroUpNULjkg.en: In Uvs Province in western Mongolia, 2 new cases were reported on 14 November. Both had slaughtered or eaten the same sick cow. Another 9 people with shared exposure are under isolation and observation.
